mission_layer: Persistent Production Memory + Cinematic Video Intelligence

roadmap_systems.title: Production Memory Manager
roadmap_systems.summary: Persist characters, beats, style, continuity, and iteration outcomes as bounded production memory.

roadmap_systems.title: Scene Graph Builder
roadmap_systems.summary: Map playable scenes, cinematic spaces, and asset relationships into reusable scene context.

roadmap_systems.title: Shot Planner
roadmap_systems.summary: Turn story beats and gameplay triggers into explicit shot plans with framing and pacing.

roadmap_systems.title: Trailer/Cutscene Director
roadmap_systems.summary: Sequence beats, reveals, and gameplay-cinematic transitions into a coherent directing pass.

roadmap_systems.title: Continuity Checker
roadmap_systems.summary: Guard tone, prop, costume, geography, and gameplay state continuity across generations.

roadmap_systems.title: Asset Reuse Tracker
roadmap_systems.summary: Track reusable shots, prompts, edits, and source assets to reduce drift and cost.

roadmap_systems.title: Gameplay Cutscene Trigger System
roadmap_systems.summary: Bind gameplay conditions and state changes to cinematic beat activation points.

roadmap_systems.title: Cinematic Prompt Compiler
roadmap_systems.summary: Compile production memory into structured shot prompts without invoking generation yet.

roadmap_systems.title: Cost-Aware Iteration System
roadmap_systems.summary: Record failed/successful attempts with cost tiers and prioritize bounded iteration loops.

roadmap_systems.title: Second Brain + Obsidian integration
roadmap_systems.summary: Export human-readable cinematic planning notes while keeping machine memory authoritative.

characters.name: BABYLON Runner
continuity_rules: Keep silhouette readable in gameplay and cinematic framing.
Do not contradict currently implemented player abilities.

environments.name: BABYLON Arena Foundation
lighting_rules: Avoid dramatic darkness that obscures gameplay state.

story_beats.title: Wave Start Pressure Beat
story_beats.summary: A short gameplay-adjacent cutscene establishes the next wave as pressure rises before control returns.
continuity_dependencies: Do not imply weapons or enemies not present in the playable build.

camera_language: brief hero inserts between combat beats
lighting: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting
continuity_rules: Cinematics must respect the live gameplay state and known-good BABYLON systems.
Do not invent props, locations, or powers that the current production case study does not support.
Shot-to-shot lighting must preserve player/enemy readability over dramatic stylization.

shots.emotional_intent: signal that a controlled cinematic beat is starting
shots.camera_behavior: brief push-in from current gameplay framing
shots.transition_notes: Do not fully break the player's spatial awareness.
shots.lighting_reference: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting

shots.camera_behavior: wide arena reveal with tactical lanes visible
shots.transition_notes: Hold only long enough to confirm geography.
shots.lighting_reference: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting

shots.emotional_intent: reveal the player as the subject of rising pressure
raise threat anticipation without obscuring play state
continuity_dependencies: Do not imply enemies outside the playable build.
shots.lighting_reference: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting

shots.emotional_intent: lock in resolve before control returns
continuity_dependencies: Keep the player ability read consistent.
shots.transition_notes: Keep this beat short and controlled.

shots.emotional_intent: prepare a clean handoff back to gameplay
continuity_dependencies: Camera must land near gameplay ownership framing.
shots.camera_behavior: decelerate back toward gameplay camera lane
shots.transition_notes: Land on a frame that can return input cleanly.
shots.lighting_reference: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting

continuity_dependencies: No discontinuity between cinematic and gameplay state.
shots.transition_notes: Input returns immediately as the wave starts.
shots.lighting_reference: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting

gameplay_cutscene_triggers.title: Wave Escalation Transition
gameplay_cutscene_triggers.gameplay_state: wave countdown active with stable arena state
gameplay_cutscene_triggers.cinematic_state: brief anticipation sequence before control returns
transition_notes: Keep the beat under a few seconds.
Return to gameplay with no camera discontinuity.

transition_notes: Planning-only until a dedicated boss sequence exists.

notes: Configured as a future manual bridge target only.
Readiness helpers must not launch or probe this runtime automatically.
Kept as a secondary compatibility path for scripted local backend experiments.

local_runtime_readiness_rules: Local runtime detection remains advisory and must not launch external runtimes automatically.
At least one configured or detected runtime, one profiled hardware target, and one candidate model must exist before local bridge review.
Readiness reports must preserve sandbox-only mode until an operator explicitly authorizes a future local execution bridge.
local_provider_routing_rules: Prefer LocalFutureProvider only when runtime, model, and hardware checks pass for the requested shot profile.
Fall back to offline-planning-mode or cloud provider comparison when local readiness is incomplete.
High continuity or long-duration shots should prefer cloud review until local model support is explicitly profiled.
local_inference_governance_rules: Local execution planning remains manual-only and non-autonomous.
No runtime launch, model download, or render job may happen from readiness helpers.
Append-only approval and continuity governance must remain unchanged before any future local bridge is considered.
local_asset_cache_strategy: Cache model weights and VAE assets separately from generated outputs.
Store reusable reference frames and conditioning assets with deterministic fingerprints.
Treat local cache eviction as an operator-reviewed storage decision, not an automatic background process.
local_inference_notes: Use LocalFutureProvider as a stable abstraction over future open-source backends.
Keep runtime detection, hardware profiling, and model registry decoupled so routing stays provider-agnostic.
Plan for Windows-friendly backends first, with DirectML and CUDA both representable in the readiness layer.

runtime_constraint_models.title: Windows Local Runtime Baseline
storage_scaling: Draft local lanes should reserve at least 24GB for weights and cache.
Higher-continuity models should reserve 40GB+ once multi-stage packaging is introduced.
render_time_scaling: 720p draft passes should be treated as the baseline timing tier.
1080p multi-stage passes may take roughly 2x the baseline planning estimate.
local_queue_pressure: Single-job local queues remain the default assumption.
Queued local packaging and upscale stages should be serialized until runtime evidence improves.
hybrid_offload_recommendations: Offload premium or long-duration shots to cloud providers when local VRAM or storage is tight.
Use local draft previews first when budget pressure is higher than fidelity pressure.

hybrid_local_cloud_strategies.summary: Reserve local inference for future low-cost draft passes after runtime readiness improves.
Use cloud providers for premium fidelity and longer continuity-sensitive renders.
Keep orchestration and planning provider-agnostic without invoking any runtime or provider execution.
Escalate to the highest continuity-preserving lane when sequence coherence is at risk.
Prefer cheaper local or draft-capable lanes when cost pressure dominates fidelity pressure.
Escalate from local to cloud when hardware evidence cannot support the requested render profile.
